question: Seven people, G, H, I, J, K, L and S, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. I sits third to the left of J. Only two people sit between J and G. Only three people sit between I and L. K sits to the immediate left of H. How many people sit between K and S when counted from the right of S?
solution:
